description: Java class implementing a node for publishing messages to AWS Lambda within the Thingsboard rule engine. It initializes an AWS Lambda client, processes messages, invokes Lambda asynchronously, and handles responses or errors.

classes.name: TbAwsLambdaNode
classes.description: Java class for AWS Lambda node in Thingsboard rule engine, handling initialization, message processing, and cleanup.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes AWS Lambda client with credentials and configuration based on node settings.

methods.name: onMsg
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, invokes AWS Lambda asynchronously, and processes responses or errors.

methods.name: toRequest
methods.description: Creates an InvokeRequest object with specified request body, function name, and qualifier.

methods.name: getResponseMsg
methods.description: Builds a response message with updated metadata and data from Lambda invocation result.

methods.name: processException
methods.description: Creates a message with error details when Lambda invocation fails.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Shuts down the AWS Lambda client during node destruction.
